message.content:
If you mean **_The Book of the Thousand Nights and a Night_**, **Volume V** is the fifth volume of Richard Francis Burton’s translation series of the Arabian Nights.[2][4] Digital copies and scans of this volume are available in public-domain archives, including Internet Archive and related library scans.[2][4][6]
